forbidden_claims: Do not call a <2% relative throughput effect 'large' regardless of statistical significance.
Do not claim a runtime speedup beyond what the frozen decision rule's PASS classification actually supports.
Do not infer that R2-11's byte-level retention effect size translates proportionally into a runtime effect size of the same magnitude.

ttft_latency_tolerance.metric: mean TTFT and mean end-to-end-time-to-final-token, PredictedProtectPolicy vs B_selected(M), at the primary 4 GiB budget
ttft_latency_tolerance.tolerance: A regression (PredictedProtectPolicy slower) is 'meaningful' and fails the PASS latency criterion if it exceeds the LARGER of: +5% relative to B_selected(M)'s mean, or +5 milliseconds absolute. This exact numeric tolerance is frozen now, before any result exists, specifically so it cannot be tuned after seeing how large an observed regression turns out to be.

applies_when: an output-equivalence failure (per output_equivalence.json) that is not resolved by a documented architectural reason
an uncontrolled-hardware-state failure (pre-run gate / hardware_contract.json mismatch)
an instrumentation failure (overhead not measured/bounded as required)
any other scientific-validity failure (e.g. a budget violation)
R2_12_BLOCKED_INVALID.note: NOT automatically R2_12_FAIL, same pattern as R2-11's BLOCKED_INVALID vs FAIL distinction.

R2_12_FAIL.applies_when: primary 4 GiB mean delta_tps <= 0 (directionally worse or no improvement), OR confirmed prediction/retention-policy CPU overhead (measured separately per instrumentation_contract.json) exceeds the measured throughput benefit such that the net real-world effect is non-positive.

R2_12_INCONCLUSIVE.applies_when: primary 4 GiB mean delta_tps > 0 (central estimate favorable) but EITHER the 95% paired-bootstrap CI includes 0, OR one or more secondary PASS criteria (consistency across workloads, dominance test, TTFT/latency tolerance) fail, with no scientific-validity failure.

requires_all: 95% paired-bootstrap CI excludes 0 in favor of PredictedProtectPolicy (CI lower bound > 0)
zero output-equivalence failures across all evaluated cells
zero memory-correctness failures (zero budget violations, peak_resident <= budget for every run)
no meaningful TTFT/end-to-end-latency regression beyond the frozen tolerance above
consistency across multiple workloads: at least 3 of the 4 corpus workloads individually show delta_tps >= 0 at the primary 4 GiB budget
result not dominated by one workload: no single improving workload contributes more than 50% of the total positive tps gain among improving workloads
deterministic scientific configuration preserved throughout (model/runtime/predictor/policy/seed/temperature/top_k/context/n_predict hashes and values unchanged for every run)

practical_effect_interpretation.note: A statistically robust but tiny throughput improvement may still justify reporting R2_12_PASS; the magnitude is reported honestly (absolute tokens/s, relative %, latency deltas, expert-I/O reduction, overhead) rather than used to override the frozen PASS/FAIL arithmetic in either direction.

research_3_gate.note: This protocol does not define a 'Research 3' gate; R2-12's own classification is the terminal scientific output of this phase of work. Starting Research 3 is explicitly out of scope and not addressed here.

budget_specific_interpretive_stance_froz.8gib_null_control: R2-11 showed an EXACT retention tie (delta=0.0) at 8 GiB. R2-12 does NOT assume runtime equality follows from that tie, but explicitly treats 8 GiB as a useful null/control condition: if 8 GiB shows a MATERIAL runtime difference despite identical retention traffic, that difference must be attributed to non-retention overhead (e.g. prediction-policy bookkeeping cost that runs regardless of whether it changes any eviction decision) or measurement noise, and investigated as such -- not reported as a retention-driven runtime effect.
budget_specific_interpretive_stance_froz.1_5gib_stress: R2-11 showed a LARGER retention improvement at 1.5 GiB. 1.5 GiB is treated as a stress/secondary condition in R2-12 and must NOT replace the 4 GiB primary budget as the basis for the R2_12_PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE classification, even if its own effect size is larger.
